table.retrieve:
SELECT
	SupplierCategory = sc.name,
	Supplier=accounts.name, 
	AliasName=accounts.aliasname, 
	OpeningBalance=sstatus.opbalance, 
	Purchase=sstatus.purchase, 
	PurchaseReturn=sstatus.preturn, 
	NetPurchase=sstatus.Purchase - sstatus.preturn, 
	Paid=sstatus.paid, 
	Debits=sstatus.dradj, 
	Credits=sstatus.cradj,
	ClosingBalance=sstatus.opbalance-sstatus.purchase+sstatus.preturn+sstatus.paid+sstatus.dradj-sstatus.cradj
FROM Supplier ac, accounts, SupplierCategory sc,
(SELECT acccode, sum(opbalance) as opbalance, 
		sum(purchase) as purchase, 
		sum(preturn) as preturn,
		sum(paid) as paid, 
		sum(dradj) as dradj, 
		sum(cradj) as cradj
FROM
	(select acccode, opbalance = sum(debit - credit), Purchase=0, preturn=0, paid=0, dradj=0, cradj=0
	from virtualgl
	where date < :ad_sdate and acccode in (select acccode from accounts where acccode IN ( Select suppcode From Supplier Where suppcatcode IN (:ai_suppcatcode) ) )
	group by acccode
	union all
	select acccode, opbalance =0, Purchase=sum(credit), preturn=0, paid=0, dradj=0, cradj=0
	from virtualgl
	where documenttype in ('PV') AND date >= :ad_sdate and date <= :ad_ldate and 
		acccode in (select acccode from accounts where acccode IN ( Select suppcode From Supplier Where suppcatcode In (:ai_suppcatcode) ))
	group by acccode
	union all
	select acccode, opbalance =0, Purchase=0, preturn=sum(debit), paid=0, dradj=0, cradj=0
	from virtualgl
	where documenttype in ('PR') AND date >= :ad_sdate and date <= :ad_ldate and 
		acccode in (select acccode from accounts where acccode IN ( Select suppcode From Supplier Where suppcatcode In (:ai_suppcatcode) ))
	group by acccode
	union all
	select acccode, opbalance =0, Purchase=0, preturn=0, paid=sum(debit-credit), dradj=0, cradj=0
	from virtualgl
	where documenttype in ('CR', 'BR', 'CP', 'BP', 'CRSALE', 'BRSALE', 'CPPUR', 'BPPUR') AND date >= :ad_sdate and date <= :ad_ldate and 
		acccode in (select acccode from accounts where acccode IN ( Select suppcode From Supplier Where suppcatcode In (:ai_suppcatcode) ))
	group by acccode
	union all
	select acccode=suppcode, opbalance =0, Purchase=0, preturn=0, paid=sum(amt), dradj=0, cradj=0
	from purledger
	where amt <> 0 AND date >= :ad_sdate and date <= :ad_ldate and accountfor='Y' and posted='Y'
	group by suppcode
	union all
	select acccode, opbalance =0, Purchase=0, preturn=0, paid=0, dradj=sum(debit), cradj=sum(credit)
	from virtualgl
	where documenttype NOT IN ('CR', 'BR', 'CP', 'BP', 'CRSALE', 'BRSALE', 'CPPUR', 'BPPUR', 'SV', 'SR', 'PV', 'PR', 'RS', 'RR') AND date >= :ad_sdate and date <= :ad_ldate and 
		acccode in (select acccode from accounts where acccode IN ( Select suppcode From Supplier Where suppcatcode In (:ai_suppcatcode) ))
	group by acccode) a
group by 
	a.acccode) sstatus
where
	ac.SuppCode = accounts.acccode and 
	ac.suppcatcode  = sc.suppcatcode and
	ac.suppcatcode IN ( :ai_suppcatcode ) and
	accounts.acccode = sstatus.acccode
ORDER BY 
	SupplierCategory, 
	Supplier,
	AliasName

objects.name: compute_12
objects.expression: if( sum(openingbalance for all) > 0, 'Dr', if( sum(openingbalance for all) < 0, 'Cr', ''))

objects.name: compute_15
objects.expression: if( sum( openingbalance - purchase + purchasereturn + paid + debits - credits for all) > 0, 'Dr',  if(sum( openingbalance - purchase + purchasereturn + paid + debits - credits for all) < 0, 'Cr',''))

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: if( openingbalance - purchase + purchasereturn + paid + debits - credits > 0, 'Dr',  if( openingbalance - purchase + purchasereturn + paid + debits - credits < 0, 'Cr',''))

objects.name: compute_13
objects.expression: abs(openingbalance - purchase + purchasereturn + paid + debits - credits)
